summary: Agent assisted customer with failed NEFT transfer due to incorrect IFSC code.

intents.keywords: नमस्ते मैं प्रियंका राठौर मेरे खाते में नेफ्ट ट्रांसफर ... दिन पहले किया था।
intents.actions of agent: Agent verified customer details, identified the incorrect IFSC code as the reason for the failure, and offered to re-initiate the transfer once the correct code is provided.
intents.Process Request: Re-initiate NEFT transfer after customer provides correct IFSC code.
intents.resolution: The agent will re-initiate the NEFT transfer once the customer provides the correct IFSC code.
